classification: pre-registered held-out evaluation of the R374 hold-30 centre; research-only
question: The R374 centre and its platform were selected using data through 2026-11-05. If the centre had been frozen at 2025-05-06, would it have held up over the following ~17 months, and would it have beaten the R360 20-day control on the same sealed segment?
hypothesis: The pre-registered hold-30 centre continues to meet the v2 gates and beats the R360 20-day control on a segment that was not used to choose it.

design.selected_cell_rule: the cell declared in R374 before any sealed-window number was computed: fade05_h30_sl20
design.control_cell: fade05_h20_sl20 (the R360 centre), with the same 27-cell grid available

procedures: Reconstruct every 27-cell portfolio curve exactly as in R371/R374 (2x cost) and truncate at the sealed-window start.
Apply the R374 pre-registered selection rule using only development-window data: take the pre-declared centre, do not reselect after seeing sealed results.
Measure the centre and the control on the sealed window only: total return, annualised return, Sharpe, max drawdown, and the excess of the centre over the control.
Also report how the sealed-window ranking of the 27 cells compares with their development-window ranking, to show whether the platform ordering persisted.
Do not use the sealed window to choose, rank, weight, or modify any parameter.

gates.centre_beats_control: sealed total return of centre > sealed total return of the R360 20-day control
gates.centre_beats_control_sharpe: sealed Sharpe of centre >= sealed Sharpe of control
gates.ranking_persistence: Spearman rank correlation between development-window and sealed-window annualised return across the 27 cells >= 0.30

decision_rules: All five gates must pass for the held-out claim to advance.
Any failed gate is recorded as evidence against out-of-sample superiority of the hold-30 change; the R374 centre can remain a parameter default but cannot be called validated out of sample.
The sealed window is evaluated once only. No additional holdout slicing may be invented after seeing these numbers to rescue the claim.
No leverage, paper target, order or production change is permitted.
known_limits: The 27-cell grid was already observed on the full 2022-2026 window in R371; this is a time-split re-read of the same curves, not newly generated data.
The B-sleeve curves are generated once from a 2022-05-05 start; the sealed window inherits that path and its warm-up.
Industry classification remains a current-snapshot backfill and HS300 membership is not point-in-time for the earliest part of the sample.
One 17-month sealed segment is a single noisy observation; failure of the ranking-persistence gate is likely even if the strategy is genuinely robust.
